failures.name: DERIVED_HELDOUT_ORDINARY_SOURCE_LAUNDERING
failures.observation: A byte-distinct ordinary-source fixture explicitly derived from a heldout benchmark case was accepted by both policy construction and policy-content validation after changing case_id/presentation metadata.
failures.root_cause: Authority checks prove exact blob and raw case_id uniqueness but do not encode benchmark lineage or transformed/derived-source exclusion.

failures.name: UNICODE_CASE_ID_NORMALIZATION_COLLISION
failures.observation: A benchmark case_id encoded in NFC and a canonically equivalent ordinary case_id encoded in NFD were accepted as distinct identities.
failures.root_cause: case_id namespace uniqueness is enforced on raw Unicode code-point strings rather than a canonical normalized identity representation.

failures.name: REGISTRY_TOCTOU_POST_HASH_SUBSTITUTION
failures.observation: Replacing the trust-policy registry after its genuine bytes were hashed but before JSON parsing allowed an attacker registry/policy to authorize and export a previously unregistered ordinary source.
failures.root_cause: Registry authentication performs identity check and content read as separate filesystem operations; the verified bytes are not the bytes subsequently parsed.

failures.name: SOURCE_TOCTOU_POST_HASH_SUBSTITUTION
failures.observation: Replacing a canonical ordinary source after its genuine bytes were hashed but before payload parsing allowed the substituted payload with the same case_id to be loaded and exported.
failures.root_cause: Source authentication hashes a path and later re-opens it for parsing; verification is not bound to a single immutable byte snapshot.
